svg.title: Cheesemaker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as cheesemaker, wearing an apron and a hair covering. Visible work cue: A round cheese wheel has an open quarter cut, two separated curd holes and a small wedge beside it. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hair covering.
